producer_report.summary: Retry briefs now carry every blocker and major finding of the retried job's final verification in both paths, in a shared 'Findings you must address' block built from one formatter in reading.rs (seeded: new must_address plus the full list; unseeded: new retry_findings lookup feeding ProducerInputs). Finding gets no resolved state. IntrospectionRecord gains planning_stopped (set from a shared prefix constant), IntrospectionJev gains context_prevention (outcome from the fixed seven or an error), Jev's call gets the optional context question with the exact text, and parse_response tolerates a missing or wrong-typed answer for it. D130 is accepted; CHANGELOG.md and docs/records.md state the choices. New tests cover the retry briefs, the real parser, the introspection path, the call text and read-back."]

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test`: a retry-brief test rejects a job with two major findings and a minor one, and asserts both major findings (summary, evidence, location) appear in the retry's producer brief in BOTH the seeded (tree_retry_seed) and unseeded paths, listed the same way; it fails if the builder drops one.
criteria_check.evidence: reading::tests::both_retry_paths_carry_every_major_finding_in_the_same_form builds the job, runs tree_retry_seed and retry_findings, checks summary/evidence/location of both majors, builds both producer briefs and asserts each '> text' line in the must-address block and the minor absent; also briefs::tests::both_retry_paths_list_the_must_address_findings_the_same_way. Both passed.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test`: a test calls the real jev.rs `parse_response` (not FakeJev) on a reply with no answer to the new context-prevention question and asserts the class and repeat answers still come back and the new field is empty; a malformed or out-of-list answer is stored as an error in the field and blocks nothing.
criteria_check.evidence: jev::tests::the_real_parser_keeps_the_required_answers_when_the_context_answer_is_missing_or_wrong calls parse_response with jev_questions; tests/introspection.rs a_missing_or_bad_context_answer_is_kept_and_blocks_nothing checks via ask_jev that missing gives None and out-of-list/wrong-type give an error with class and repeat still stored. Passed.

criteria_check.evidence: tests/introspection.rs: a_job_that_failed_in_planning_is_marked_and_carries_the_context_field (real planned run, planning_stopped true, outcome in list), jevs_call_asks_... open_issues: A context-prevention answer with an unreadable shape (not a valid Answer at all) still fails the whole reply in parse_response; only a missing or wrong-typed answer is tolerated.

The plan's stated step of moving the blocking selection into reading.rs as a separate function was done as a position-based pick from the redacted findings inside tree_retry_seed instead; behavior is the same.
I could not read the persisted full-suite output (outside the working directory), so the full cargo test result is judged by the command's exit status.
mistakes: First clippy run failed on field_reassign_with_default in my new planning test; fixed with a struct-update initializer.
First brief test cut the must-address block at the wrong place because the seeded brief's next paragraph is not a heading; fixed by also stopping at 'All of the'.
learnings: Planning helpers (plan and critique JSON) live in job_plan.rs, so introspection.rs needs its own copy to drive a planning-stopped job.
Most test literals build IntrospectionJev through ask_jev, so only IntrospectionRecord literals needed the new planning_stopped field.
The planner's Finding formatter existed as three inline copies; the critique-round copy has a different format and was left alone.
